content.user_title: Analyze App Reviews and Prepare Approved Replies
content.value_statement: App reviews scatter complaints, feature requests, and praise across individual messages. This skill uses ASOScan insights and review evidence to prioritize actions and prepare individually approved replies.
actual_capabilities: Summarize review sentiment with positive, neutral, and negative shares and an average score shown on its -1 to +1 range.
Rank recurring topics, feature requests, and reported bugs by count, then recommend responses for the top three themes.
Retrieve paginated raw reviews, filter by star rating, and quote review bodies verbatim as evidence.
Analyze apps in the ASOScan account and competitors already tracked by that account.
Read saved reply templates and request AI reply drafts after disclosing costs and obtaining consent.
Post one developer reply only after approval of its exact text, subject to the app having a store connection.
limitations: Live data requires connected ASOScan tools or shell access with an existing ASOSCAN_API_KEY; neither connection is included in this skill.
Coverage is limited to account apps and tracked competitors; pending analysis can leave some reviews outside the insights.
AI drafting costs 2 API credits and 1 AI credit; posting costs 2 API credits and requires exact-text approval.
Posting requires a store connection in ASOScan, and developer replies are not a search-ranking signal.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Product Improvements
use_cases.description: Review frequent complaints and requests, inspect supporting reviews, and identify three concrete roadmap or onboarding actions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Individual Review Replies
use_cases.description: Start from saved templates, request a draft after cost approval, and approve the exact response before publication.

use_cases.title: Study Tracked Competitor Feedback
use_cases.description: Inspect sentiment and recurring review themes for an already tracked competitor to identify messaging and product opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Review Sentiment
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize review sentiment for [app]. Show the score range and analyzed count, and disclose pending reviews.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: obtain a concise sentiment overview.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Frequent Complaints
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the top three complaints for [app]. Retrieve supporting one-star reviews and quote them exactly. Recommend an owner and response for each theme.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: connect recurring complaints to review evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Review Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Find review [review ID] for [app] and offer a saved template. Ask before paid drafting, then show the draft without posting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a response while retaining publication control.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Feedback and Prioritize Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [my app] with [tracked competitor] using sentiment and theme counts. Quote supporting reviews and flag incomplete analysis. Recommend three actions without changing data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: synthesize feedback across account apps and tracked competitors.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied data: 100 analyzed reviews and 10 pending. Sentiment: 60% positive, 25% neutral, 15% negative, average 0.38. Login complaints: 12.
output: Average sentiment: 0.38 on a -1 to +1 scale; mildly positive.
Coverage: 100 reviews analyzed, with 10 still pending.
Priority: investigate login failures reported in 12 reviews.
Evidence: no raw review text was supplied, so no direct quotation is included.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied review: "The app crashes when I upload a photo." Prepare a response without posting or making a paid draft request.
output: Review: "The app crashes when I upload a photo."
Suggested response: "Thank you for reporting the photo upload crash. Please contact support with your device model and app version so we can investigate."
Publication status: not posted. The exact text requires approval before a posting request.

best_practices: Show analyzed and pending counts, and always include the -1 to +1 sentiment score range.
Support priorities with retrieved reviews and preserve quoted review text exactly.
Keep credentials private, approve chargeable drafts first, and approve each reply text separately before publication.
anti_patterns: Inventing reviews, presenting paraphrases as quotations, or treating pending reviews as already analyzed.
Posting unapproved replies, applying one approval to multiple replies, or hiding drafting costs.
Presenting developer replies as a search-ranking tactic or claiming access to untracked competitors.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live operations also require connected ASOScan tools or the documented shell fallback.

faq.question: Do I need to provide an API key?
faq.answer: Connected ASOScan tools do not require a key in chat. The shell fallback uses an existing ASOSCAN_API_KEY and must never print it.

faq.question: Can I analyze competitor reviews?
faq.answer: Yes, if the competitor is already tracked in your ASOScan account. The skill does not provide unrestricted access to arbitrary apps.

faq.question: What operations cost credits?
faq.answer: The documented reads are free. AI drafting costs 2 API credits and 1 AI credit; posting costs 2 API credits.

faq.question: Will the skill post replies automatically?
faq.answer: No. Each reply requires approval of its exact text, and posting requires a connected App Store Connect or Google Play Console account.

faq.question: What does the sentiment score mean?
faq.answer: The average score ranges from -1 for very negative to +1 for very positive. Zero is neutral; pending reviews indicate incomplete analysis.
